ns2:section.sectionText: Interested students should email the instructor for approval: yoosong@illinois.edu. This course is designed primarily for undergraduate students with academic or professional backgrounds in consulting or advisory services. The course will present real-world projects that require advanced knowledge and skills in various fields of information sciences. Students will manage entire consulting engagements and produce professional-level deliverables.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
